claims.claim_text: At v0.80.6, Pi's coding path layers pi-ai, the low-level Agent, and pi-coding-agent's AgentSession; the separate AgentHarness implementation is present but is not imported by coding-agent source and its pinned design document marks lifecycle work as provisional.

claims.confidence: high for the pinned repository; the import absence is version-bounded

claims.claim_text: The low-level loop is model-directed over tool calls, with deterministic code owning event order, turn snapshots, queue-drain points, tool scheduling, termination hints, cancellation, and provider-failure normalization.
claims.confidence: high for v0.80.6; no effectiveness implication

references.notes: Control flow and representative regression tests inspected directly.

claims.claim_text: Pi builds each coding prompt from active tools and guidelines, project/global instruction files, skills metadata, date, and cwd, while refreshing model, tools, system prompt, and thinking level between tool turns.
claims.confidence: high; concrete runs remain configuration- and extension-dependent

references.notes: Direct prompt and per-turn refresh paths.

claims.claim_text: Pi validates tool arguments, exposes pre/post extension hooks, defaults to parallel tool execution unless a tool or configuration forces sequential execution, bounds tool observations, and refuses to execute calls from a length-truncated assistant response; trusted pre-call hooks can mutate the validated argument object before execution.
claims.confidence: high for mechanics; trusted hooks are inside the trust boundary

references.notes: Code and tests cover validation, scheduling, hook mutation, truncation, and fail-closed length handling.

claims.claim_text: Pi preserves an append-only tree-shaped session separately from the compaction-aware active model context, enabling retained history and branching even when older entries leave the model view.
claims.confidence: high; in-memory mode is not durable

claims.claim_text: Default coding-session compaction uses a model-generated structured summary plus a retained recent tail, triggered manually, by threshold, or by overflow; overflow may compact and retry once.
claims.confidence: high for implementation; semantic retention and task benefit are unmeasured

references.notes: Mechanism and recovery paths verified; no outcome metric found.

claims.claim_text: Delegation is not a primitive of the default core loop; the pinned repository demonstrates single, parallel, and chained subagents as an optional extension that spawns separate Pi processes.
claims.confidence: high for the inspected boundary; extensions make deployed behavior open-ended

references.location: absence in packages/agent and default coding core; packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/subagent/index.ts:1-700
references.notes: Repository-wide search plus direct optional-extension inspection.

claims.claim_text: Pi intentionally provides no built-in permission system or sandbox; project trust gates resource loading, while execution containment is assigned to extensions or external OS/virtualization boundaries.
claims.confidence: high for declared and code-consistent policy; no security-effectiveness claim

references.notes: Pinned vendor documentation and consistent resource-loading behavior.

claims.claim_text: Pi provides retry and context-overflow recovery for runtime failures, but the default inspected path has no independent task-success verifier, acceptance gate, or rollback policy.
claims.confidence: high for present and absent code at the pin; extensions can add policy

references.notes: Direct recovery implementation and bounded absence search.
